title: Sales By Customer's Sales Type menu has Select all and Clear selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the Sales Type filter on first load.
  2. Click "Clear selection".
  3. Click "Select all".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Part Sales" and "Service Sales" each have a checkbox and both are ticked; a "Select all" row is above them and "Clear selection" at the bottom.
  • Step 2: both options are cleared and the filter reads "Sales Type: No sales".
  • Step 3: both options are ticked again and the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S8-R7, S8-R8, read 19 Oct 2026. "SBC (Sales By Customer) Report" spec, Confluence 577634305, version 21 (6 Oct 2026), S3-R2, S3-R3, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R7: “Its two options read "Part Sales" and "Service Sales".”
  • S8-R8: “With both options selected, the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales". With one, it reads that option's name, for example "Sales Type: Part Sales". With none, it reads "Sales Type: No sales".”
  • Sales By Customer spec, S3-R2: “Its menu offers two options, each with a checkbox, "Part Sales" and "Service Sales", under a "Select all" row, with "Clear selection" at the bottom.”
  • Sales By Customer spec, S3-R3: “Both options are selected on first load.”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), pages 4 and 5 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases.
